import asyncio

def test_customer_id() -> str:

@pytest.fixture

# 1. HAPPY PATH TESTS

class TestHappyPath:
    """Complete order flow verification."""

    async def test_order_completes_successfully(self, services, test_customer_id, test_items):
        """Verify full order flow: create -> reserve -> pay -> confirm -> notify."""
        order = await services["order"].create_order(test_customer_id, test_items)
        assert order.status == OrderStatus.PENDING

        confirmed = await services["order"].wait_for_status(
            order.order_id, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, timeout_seconds=30
        )

        assert confirmed.status == OrderStatus.CONFIRMED
        assert confirmed.payment_id is not None

        # Verify inventory reserved
        reservations = await services["inventory"].get_reservations(order.order_id)
        assert len(reservations) == 2

        # Verify payment processed
        payment = await services["payment"].get_payment(confirmed.payment_id)
        assert payment.status == "success"

        # Verify notification sent
        notifications = await services["notification"].get_notification_by_order(order.order_id)
        assert any(n["type"] == "order_confirmed" for n in notifications)


# 2. SERVICE FAILURE SCENARIOS

class TestServiceFailures:
    """Each service failure triggers appropriate compensation."""

    async def test_inventory_failure_fails_order(self, services, test_customer_id, test_items):
        await services["chaos"].inject_failure("inventory", "error_500", 60)

        order = await services["order"].create_order(test_customer_id, test_items)
        failed = await services["order"].wait_for_status(
            order.order_id, OrderStatus.FAILED, timeout_seconds=30
        )

        assert failed.status == OrderStatus.FAILED
        assert "inventory" in failed.failure_reason.lower()

    async def test_payment_declined_unreserves_inventory(self, services, test_customer_id, test_items):
        await services["chaos"].inject_failure("payment", "payment_declined", 60)
        initial_stock = await services["inventory"].get_stock_level("WIDGET-001")

        order = await services["order"].create_order(test_customer_id, test_items)
        await services["order"].wait_for_status(order.order_id, OrderStatus.FAILED)

        # Compensation: inventory unreserved
        final_stock = await services["inventory"].get_stock_level("WIDGET-001")
        assert final_stock == initial_stock

    async def test_notification_failure_does_not_fail_order(self, services, test_customer_id, test_items):

        await services["chaos"].inject_failure("notification", "error_503", 60)

        order = await services["order"].create_order(test_customer_id, test_items)
        confirmed = await services["order"].wait_for_status(order.order_id, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED)

        assert confirmed.status == OrderStatus.CONFIRMED

        reservations = await services["inventory"].get_reservations(order.order_id)
